query: What is the minimum attendance required to appear for the end-term exams?
expected: 75% in every course (Handbook 7.2); may be relaxed to no less than 65% for medical exigencies or representing State/India, with Vice-Chancellor approval (7.3-7.4).
label: correct
answer:
**The minimum attendance is 75% of the classes actually conducted, in every course you register for** (Handbook 7.2).

| Situation | Minimum | Who decides | Clause |
|---|---|---|---|
| Normal rule | 75% | Not applicable | 7.2 |
| Serious medical case: hospitalisation, trauma or contagious disease (yours or a family member's), with documents | Can be relaxed, never below 65% | Faculty Advisor recommends to Program Chair; Vice-Chancellor approves | 7.3 |
| Representing the State or India in an event, with certificates | Can be relaxed, never below 65% | Director, Campus Life and Faculty Advisor recommend to Program Chair; Vice-Chancellor approves | 7.4 |

Below the applicable minimum you cannot sit the end-term exam for that course and receive an FA grade (7.6).
sources: Student Handbook Aug 2026.pdf | Section III - Academic Regulations > 7. Attendance Requirements (7.2), p. 21

expected: SOP is internally inconsistent: 'Course Registration Deadline' allows late registration up to one week (no extensions), while 'Late Registration' says no late registration except medical/competition cases, up to two weeks (Handbook 2.6 agrees with the latter).
label: correct
answer: The University documents contain an inconsistency regarding late registration. The SOP states under 'Late Registration' that no late registration shall be permitted except for medical exigencies or competitions, but under 'Course Registration Deadline' it states a maximum of one calendar week is permissible. Meanwhile, the Student Handbook (Clauses 2.6 and 2.7) allows late registration for medical cases up to two weeks, for competitions/events with approval, and for any other reason up to one calendar week upon paying a Late Fee. Please confirm the exact rule with the Program Chair or the Office of the Registrar.
